exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
executionSteps: Set your feet firmly and brace before you descend.
Sit between your hips while keeping your whole foot grounded.
Drive the floor away and finish tall without leaning back.
commonMistakes: Rushing the setup before the brace is established.
Using momentum instead of owning the full range.
Letting discomfort turn into sharp or pinching pain.
safetyNotes: Reduce depth or load if the knee or hip feels sharp pain.
Use a stable support when learning the pattern.

Keep posture relaxed and repeat smooth, efficient strokes or steps.
Increase speed only while technique stays quiet and controlled.
commonMistakes: Rushing the setup before the brace is established.
Using momentum instead of owning the full range.
Letting discomfort turn into sharp or pinching pain.
safetyNotes: Build volume gradually and keep impact appropriate for joints.
Slow down if breathing or gait becomes uncontrolled.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
executionSteps: Move into the starting position slowly and breathe out.
Explore the range without forcing the joint or bouncing.
Return with control and repeat on the other side when appropriate.
commonMistakes: Rushing the setup before the brace is established.
Using momentum instead of owning the full range.
Letting discomfort turn into sharp or pinching pain.
safetyNotes: Stretch sensation is acceptable; sharp joint pain is not.
Use small ranges when returning from injury.
